name: TWDisaster
title: Taiwan Historical Disaster Dataset
description: Source-supported historical weather-related disaster events and factual response observations in Taiwan.
geographic_scope: Taiwan; native source area precision retained, no released geometry

temporal_scope.meaning: Compiled source-reported event windows, not exact meteorological onset or cessation

rights_summary: Original documentation, schema definitions, and dataset selection and arrangement: CC BY 4.0. Factual records require attribution to their original government publishers and remain subject to source-level website reuse statements; no original source payloads are included. See DATA_LICENSE.md and data/sources.csv.
coverage_note: Positive-only, rights-screened response observations; not a complete Taiwan disaster or action inventory.
